description: Animated local Codex usage and API-equivalent cost dashboard

defaultPrompt: Open my animated Codex usage dashboard.
Show my last 30 days of Codex usage as ASCII charts.
Show my Codex API-equivalent cost by repository.
interface.longDescription: View token activity, model usage, API-equivalent cost, and cost by repository. The bundled skill reads local Codex history and opens an animated dashboard in a new macOS Terminal window. Requires Node.js 22.13 or newer.

name: codex-cost
